title: Battlefield object kinds
description: data/objects/kinds.json: the breakable things on a fight's battlefield (F5; combat/battle_object.gd, combat/encounter_objects.gd). Armor Class by substance and Hit Points by size and sturdiness follow the 2024 rules glossary's Breaking Objects tables.

substances.description: Armor Class by what an object is made of.

hit_points.description: Hit Points by size: fragile or resilient.

area_types.description: Damage types a spell's area deals to the objects in it (deviations.md: Area spells and objects).

fire_light.description: The light a burning object or square sheds, in feet.

default_kind.description: A '=' square's kind when nothing else names one.

themes.description: Board theme -> the kind its '=' squares default to (when the art on the square names no kind).

doors.description: Which kind a location's closed door is: the first rule with a word in its id or label, else the default.

substance.description: A key of `substances` (its Armor Class), unless `ac` is given.

hp.description: Hit Points, overriding the size table's.

blocks.description: What it makes its squares: a wall (doors), low cover (furniture, crates), or nothing (overhead, a web).

leaves.description: What its squares become when it breaks: open floor, Difficult Terrain rubble, an open doorway.

art.description: Board and prop art (art/sprites/props) that is this kind; art no kind names isn't breakable.

hangs.description: It hangs over its squares (a chandelier): only ranged attacks and spells reach it, and breaking it drops it on whoever is below.

moves.description: What a creature beside it can do to it (ObjectActions): shove it 5 ft (one attack of the Attack action), or push it over (the Utilize action), each with a Strength (Athletics) check against move_dc.

move_dc.description: The Strength (Athletics) DC to shove it or push it over.

throwable.description: Small enough to pick up and throw as an improvised weapon; it breaks where it lands.

topple.description: Pushed over, it falls across `length` squares: each creature on the floor there makes a Dexterity save against `dc` or takes `damage` and falls Prone; rubble is left (and burning coals, with `coals`).

bursts.description: Fire sets it off (a barrel of lamp oil): everyone within `radius` feet makes the save against `dc`, taking `damage` on a failure and half on a success; with `oil` the floor around it is left burning.

fall.description: What a hanging object does to the creatures under it as it falls: a save, damage on a failure (half on a success), and Prone on a failure.
